channel.title: Cultura Data-Driven (EN)
channel.description: Independent digital magazine on data science, artificial intelligence, business, technology, society and chronicles. Reality sends signals.

item.title: Do data-driven companies perform better?
item.description: Yes, there is an advantage — but it shows up when data changes decisions, not when a company buys tools. What 15 years of studies and the 2026 surveys say.

item.title: How much would you pay for this mayonnaise? Artificial intelligence wants to find out.
item.description: From the supermarket to the algorithm: how artificial intelligence is changing pricing strategy, marketing and the way we understand consumers.

item.title: The clock was wrong
item.description: The story of Seu Osvaldo, who was never late.

item.title: The sale that never happened
item.description: Seu Álvaro knows exactly what doesn’t sell. His customers disagree.

item.title: The construction site started generating data
item.description: Chinese robots that paint, sand, level concrete and scan the site arrived in Brazil. To work, they need one thing above all: data.

item.title: The tapioca nobody sold
item.description: The customer wanted. The bakery could make. The problem was nobody had introduced the two.

item.title: Data-Driven Culture without the fuss
item.description: It is not Power BI, it is not AI, it is not having lots of data. It is turning reality into consequence.

item.title: Stop deciding on 'I think'
item.description: Experience is too valuable to discard — and too dangerous to become proof without investigation.
